author: reek
body: Menu interaction logic for the Codex Aquarium. This module is compiled to JavaScript via the JavaScript plug. All DOM access uses Codex DOM builtins which the JS emitter maps to browser APIs.

author: reek
body: The bridge JS (js-c22) defines feedFish, tapGlass, toggleLight, addFishByName. This module provides underscore aliases and the event delegation setup that wires data-action / data-species attributes to those bridge functions.
